name: Resource Policy Misconfiguration Abuse
description: S3 buckets, Lambda functions, and other resources can have resource-based policies that grant access. Misconfigurations such as Principal: '*' or overly broad account allowlists enable access without prior AWS credentials. An attacker discovers these misconfigured resources (via enumeration, public disclosure, or scanning) and accesses them. For S3, they use s3:GetObject; for Lambda, lambda:InvokeFunction. The attacker may use the AWS CLI, SDK, or curl with pre-signed URLs. No IAM credentials needed if the resource policy allows anonymous or broad access.
